observation: Front, top and iso inspected together as one contact sheet at 500 px a view. Globe plus a broad, near-horizontal ring plate with the support web filling under its low side and running down to the disc. Front view shows the plate tilted about 27 degrees off horizontal and projecting well past the globe on both sides -- a brim, not a hoop. Top view shows the plate as a wide open ellipse almost as big as the disc. The web meets the disc without a gap. Nothing floating, no plate detached from the globe.
